title: Add Meta and Shallow Types to Python Library
description: Add Meta and Shallow Types to Python Library
summary: Added Meta and Shallow TypedDict types to semio/py/main.py for all entities with Diff equivalents. Added 16 sub-entity Meta types (AttributeMeta, TagMeta, ConceptMeta, StatMeta, PropMeta, AuthorMeta, FileMeta, FolderMeta, QualityMeta, PortMeta, ModelMeta, ConnectorMeta, LayerMeta, PieceMeta, GroupMeta, ConnectionMeta), 3 main entity Meta types (TypeMeta, DesignMeta, KitMeta), 3 Shallow types (TypeShallow, DesignShallow, KitShallow), 19 toMeta conversion functions, 3 toShallow conversion functions, and 7 tests. All 29 tests pass (1 pre-existing failure unchanged).
